rows.note: This is the all-purpose way to express respect and admiration for someone's abilities or qualities.

example.english: My admiration for my teacher makes me work harder.
example.traditional: 我對老師嘅敬佩，令我更加努力。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 lou5 si1 ge3 ging3 pui3 ling6 ngo5 gang3 gaa1 nou5 lik6

rows.note: Use this when the admiration is intense and A is treated like an idol or hero.

example.english: My admiration for that singer has become almost fanatical.
example.traditional: 我對嗰位歌手嘅崇拜，真係去到近乎瘋狂。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 go2 wai2 go1 sau2 ge3 sung4 baai3 zan1 hai6 heoi3 dou3 gan6 fu4 fung1 kong4

rows.note: Use this for idealizing or looking up to a distinguished person, especially from a distance.

example.english: My admiration for that writer has always stayed in my heart.
example.traditional: 我對嗰位作家嘅仰慕，一直都只係放喺心入面。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 go2 wai2 zok3 gaa1 ge3 joeng5 mou6 jat1 zik6 dou1 zi2 hai6 fong3 hai2 sam1 jap6 min6
